item.title: Kebbi Govt Donates 10 New Hilux to Boost Security on Sokoto–Badagry Super Highway
item.description: In a significant move to enhance the safety of workers on the strategic Sokoto–Badagary Super Highway, the Kebbi State Government has donated 10 brand-new Toyota Hilux vehicles to the Federal Ministry of Works.The vehicles were officially handed over to the Minister of State for Works, Bello Muhammad Goronyo, during a brief ceremony. item.title: EU fines Musk’s X $140m for transparency violations
item.description: The European Union hit Elon Musk’s X with a 120-million-euro ($140-million) fine on Friday for breaking its digital rules, in a move that risks a fresh clash with US President Donald Trump’s administration.The high-profile probe into the social media platform was seen as a test of the EU’s resolve to police Big Tech. item.title: Dangote announces plan to become world’s largest fertiliser producer by 2028
item.description: Aliko Dangote, chairman of the Dangote Group, says his company will become the world’s number one fertiliser producer by 2028. item.title: Nigeria’s security in good hands with General Musa — Bishop Kukah
item.description: The Catholic Archbishop of Sokoto Diocese, Matthew Kukah, has expressed optimism that with General Christopher Musa (retd) as Minister of Defence, Nigeria’s security is in capable hands. Bishop Kukah expressed this confidence on Thursday while addressing State House correspondents after attending the swearing-in ceremony of General Musa at the Aso Rock Villa, Abuja. item.title: FULL DRAW: Ghana get difficult group as Morocco face Brazil at 2026 World Cup
item.description: Ghana have been drawn against England, Croatia, and Panama in the group stage of the 2026 World Cup. The draws were held on Friday at the Kennedy Centre in Washington D.C., US. The Black Stars are in a difficult Group L with two European powerhouses, both of whom reached the quarter-finals of the previous World Cup in Qatar.
